facts.fact: 雨停后 Cándido 携玫瑰上门正式求婚（一个月订婚年底完婚），Perla 偏头拒绝
facts.anchor: “I wanted to have a serious talk with you.

facts.fact: Perla 对两个求婚者都不满：心结是 Norberto Bustillo——她此生唯一爱过、被妹妹夺走的男人
facts.anchor: the memory of the one man she’d ever loved and whom her sister had taken from her: Norberto Bustillo

facts.fact: Perla 视侄女为兽笼里的动物：归她驱使圈养
facts.anchor: the same way a wild animal, a jaguar or a wolf, might be kept in a menagerie

facts.fact: 闪回：Veracruz 求偶季，Norberto 登场吻手直视；Encarnación 歌声赢得满堂彩
facts.anchor: When the applause comes, it is thunderous

facts.fact: 反转：Norberto 电报求娶的是 Encarnación（父亲促成、为公司合并）
facts.anchor: He has decided to ask for Encarnación’s hand in marriage.

facts.fact: Encarnación 拒绝替嫁：她爱 Rómulo；周五清晨与 Rómulo 私奔，留信「别找她，原谅她」
facts.anchor: Encarnación has run away with Rómulo. Do not look for her. Forgive her.

facts.fact: 父亲宣告彻底破产：与 Bustillo 公司合并是唯一活路，如今全毁
facts.anchor: We’ve lost everything. I’ve borrowed a great deal of money

facts.fact: Perla 对 Inés 的产权观：本可把侄女交给 Salvador 打发走，却留下折辱——她属于这个家
facts.anchor: although she had humbled the girl, as was her right
